因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

log( ewm_mean(20, down_ret^2)^0.5 / ewm_mean(20, up_ret^2)^0.5 ) * (20)

  1. 1. fillna —— 缺失值填充

  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(log(clip(divide(power(ts_ema(power(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) < 0), ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), log(-1)), 2), 20), 0), power(ts_ema(power(where((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) > 0), ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), log(-1)), 2), 20), 0)), 1e-06, 1)), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)))

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  3. 计算 up_ret：np.where(ret > 0, ret, 空)
  4. 计算 down_ret：np.where(ret < 0, ret, 空)
  5. 计算 span：20
  6. 计算 up_var：pd.Series(up_ret**2, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=span, min_periods=5).mean()
  7. 计算 down_var：pd.Series(down_ret**2, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=span, min_periods=5).mean()
  8. 计算 up_vol：up_var.pow(0.5)
  9. 计算 down_vol：down_var.pow(0.5)
  10. 计算 ratio：down_vol / up_vol
  11. 计算 asym：np.log(ratio.clip(lower=1e-6))
  12. 计算 factor：asym * vol_ratio
  13. 计算 factor：factor

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_asym_vol_gated_by_volume_pressure(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"] ret = close.pct_change() up_ret = np.where(ret > 0, ret, np.nan) down_ret = np.where(ret < 0, ret, np.nan) span = 20 up_var = pd.Series(up_ret**2, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=span, min_periods=5).mean() down_var = pd.Series(down_ret**2, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=span, min_periods=5).mean() up_vol = up_var.pow(0.5) down_vol = down_var.pow(0.5) ratio = down_vol / up_vol.replace(0, np.nan) asym = np.log(ratio.clip(lower=1e-6)) _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20) factor = asym * vol_ratio factor = factor.fillna(0) df_copy["factor_asym_vol_gated_by_volume_pressure"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_asym_vol_gated_by_volume_pressure"]
